stakes: avoid a predatory agent or contract
protect wellbeing beyond the playing career
activative_input.participation_design: Each frame closes on one checkable action (verify a license, ask one question) instead of a general warning.
activative_input.intended_reaction: The reader re-checks a specific claim their agent or club made instead of accepting it at face value.

wrong_reading_locks: The blue check-mark + @handle styling must not be read as an authentic, platform-verified screenshot or an endorsement by X/Twitter -- nothing in this format certifies the underlying account exists or actually posted this.

Bold percentage stat callouts (e.g. '39% of retired players...') must not be read as sourced, peer-reviewed statistics -- the format carries no citation mechanism, so numbers are illustrative framing only unless a real citation is attached downstream.

Checklist/assertion language ('a real trial = FREE. Point.', 'an honest club = a contract with a reconversion clause') must not be read as legal, financial, or regulatory advice -- this is career-education commentary, not professional counsel.

A dark-mode and light-mode export of the same slug are the same assertion in two skins, not two different claims -- a build must not let the color-mode swap silently change the wording, since only the WHY-bound copy is invariant, not the palette.

This harness's persona name, photo, and handle must not be swapped for a different real individual's identity without a corresponding, consent-backed identity_dna_ref -- this format must not become a generic template for attributing fabricated assertions to whoever's photo is dropped in.
wrong_reading_locks_meaning: Do not soften assertion tone with defensive qualifiers -- PRM-BUS-001 demands direct declarative stance.
Do not dilute claim clarity -- PRM-PSY-018 focuses on singular core truth.
